description: Estimated output, price impact and minimum output for a swap in one DEX pair, using the pair's reserves from DexScreener and a constant-product (x*y=k) model with a fee. Exact for constant-product pools (for example Aerodrome volatile pools, Uniswap V2 style); for concentrated-liquidity pools (labelled v3 or v4) it is only an approximation. Raydium is not covered. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

amount.description: Amount you give, in that token's units (positive number)

chain.description: DexScreener chain name, e.g. base, ethereum, arbitrum (default base)

side.description: sell = you give the base token; buy = you give the quote token (default sell)
